paragraphs.text: Donkey is an acorn and playtest card creature type for cards that depict a species of equine in the same family as the Horse that is often used as a pack animal. Anthropomorphic donkeys appeared in Unhinged . Despite physical similarities these have with the Noggle , the two races hold no relationship.

Donkey debuted as a creature type in Unhinged on a cycle with five common Donkeys of each color, along with a Lord . They are all depicted as an anthropomorphic bipedal race of Donkeys with a class. They are alternately referred to as Ass (an abbreviation of the Latin name Asinus), which allowed the Un-cards to be named after epithets referring to another kind of ass . The main cycle of Donkeys features Bad Ass , Cheap Ass , Dumb Ass , Fat Ass , and Smart Ass . None of these has a whole number for Power and Toughness . Instead, each has an additional 1/2 added. The Assquatch is a Donkey Lord ; giving each Donkey +1 1/2 to power and toughness.
No cards depict the normal animal form of the Donkey. It was however featured on a token created by an Unknown Event playtest card .
